title: ICML 2026

sections.text: Hojin Ko from our lab presented his poster at ICML 2026, held at COEX in Seoul. His presentation was titled “Beyond the Bellman Recursion: A Pontryagin-Guided Framework for Non-Exponential Discounting.” 👏
